verdict.rationale: Paperspace docs show machines can be created with a public IP address and a private network enabled (docs-25), and shared drives are accessible across machines on a private network (docs-4). That implies apps can be served and instances can be connected, but nothing explicitly documents exposing ports or how private networking is configured. Missing for 10: explicit port exposure/firewall configuration docs, details on configuring private networking between machines, independent or hands-on corroboration.
